desc:
Tired of losing your time grinding for nothing? Play Dungeon RNG and get rewarded for your time and efforts with powerful swords!

What is Dungeon RNG? 
-🎲 Click the "Roll" button to get 900+ Blades
-☠️ Defeat 68 Dungeons and earn Rewards
-💍 Craft unique Relics with your Blades!
-📈 Level up and progress in the SkillTree
-🎣 Fish awesome rewards at the Fishing pond!
-💤 Roll in the AFK Area to increase your Luck!
-⚔️ Defeat players dungeon to climb PVP leaderboard!

🐎Traveling Merchant (Spawn 7mins every hours)

😲NOW Rolls Offline! Come back to grab your loot!
